recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-17075 follow-up is needed unless a separate issue reopens the broader PATCH/history wording family, which is outside this seed and does not affect the request/response requirement.
issue_request: FHIR-17075 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Feed issue raised against STU3 asking whether Bundle history entries must contain entry.request and entry.response, with a resolution to make clear that history Bundles must have entry.response for each entry and comments also addressing the missing request constraint.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-17075 was found. The likely initial application was the closely related GF#14550/FHIR-14550 commit c613b68 from 2018-07-06, which made request mandatory for batch/transaction/history and added Bundle history prose saying a response element SHALL also be present, matching the later FHIR-17075 comment that the work was already done for another task.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-38942 intentionally moved Bundle entry SHALL requirements into invariants, and current bdl-3b requires history entries to have both request.exists() and response.exists(). The existing combined-branch FHIR-7933 reconciliation commit 2923d2b222 also aligned source/http.html with the current request/response requirement.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active source already contains the requested rule in Bundle notes, the authoritative StructureDefinition invariant, and HTTP history guidance; adding further prose would be redundant.
